name: oracle
description: Step 8's three oracle configurations (implementation-plan.md M6 + Step 8 brief). min_size is raised to 8 in every config, not the 1998 default of 4 -- docs/predictions.md P8.1 predicted (and docs/decisions.md D26 records, once measured) that size=4 dominates build cost by roughly an order of magnitude over size=16, making a full 24-image x 3-config build at min_size=4 impractical in one session. 'default' matches this project's other gates' BASE params with that one change; 'max32' exercises the larger max_size (and P7.1's u32-headroom worst case); 'coarse-shift' exercises a sparser domain pool at SHIFT=8, the one M6 config axis no other gate varies.

configs.label: default
configs.description: min_size=8, max_size=16, shift=4, bits_alfa=4, bits_beta=7, max_alfa=1.0 -- this project's other gates' BASE params with min_size raised from 4 to 8 (P8.1/D26).

configs.label: max32
configs.description: Same as 'default' but max_size=32 -- exercises the larger block size and P7.1's u32-accumulator worst case.

configs.label: coarse-shift
configs.description: Same as 'default' but shift=8 -- a sparser domain pool; SHIFT is one of M6's named config axes and had not been exercised at a different value anywhere before Step 8.
